goal: Is ke baad aap samjha sakein ge ke programming kya hai, programming languages ke levels ke naam misaalon ke saath bata sakein ge, aur yeh wajah de sakein ge ke C++ ko middle-level language kyun kehte hain.
warmup: Recipe cook ko batati hai ke kya karna hai: ingredients (input), steps (processing) aur akhir mein tayyar dish (output). Agar koi step missing ho ya ghalat order mein ho to dish kharab ho jati hai. Program computer ke liye recipe hai. Lekin computer ek aise cook ki tarah hai jo soch nahi sakta: woh bilkul wohi karta hai jo recipe mein likha ho, chahe recipe ghalat hi kyun na ho.
definition: Computer instructions ko bohat tezi se follow karta hai lekin khud se soch nahi sakta. Program step by step instructions ka mukammal set hota hai. Programming in instructions ko likhne ka kaam hai, aur jo yeh kaam karta hai usay programmer kehte hain. Programming language ek formal language hoti hai jis ke fixed rules (syntax) hote hain aur jis mein instructions likhe jaate hain. Languages ko is baat se group kiya jata hai ke woh hardware ke kitni qareeb hain (low level) ya insaanon ke kitni qareeb hain (high level).
howItWorks: Taqreeban har program IPO model follow karta hai: Input (di gayi data), Processing (calculation ya decisions), Output (dikhaya gaya result). Languages ke levels hote hain. Low-level languages machine ke qareeb hoti hain: machine language (sirf 0 aur 1) aur assembly (chhote codes jaise MOV, ADD). Yeh tez hoti hain lekin likhna mushkil hota hai aur sirf ek qisam ki machine par chalti hain. High-level languages jaise Python, Java aur C# English jaisi lagti hain aur kai machines par chalti hain, lekin aam taur par slow hoti hain. C aur C++ ko middle level kehte hain kyunke inmein high-level features (functions, classes, parhne mein aasaan syntax) bhi hain aur low-level features jaise pointers aur direct memory control bhi. Levels is liye hain ke insaanon ko words aasaan lagte hain aur machines ko 0 aur 1 aasaan lagte hain, to hum aasaani aur control ke darmiyan choose karte hain. Translator (agla lesson) hamare code ko machine language mein badalta hai. Bohat si kitabein C++ ko sirf high level kehti hain; exam mein dono jawab aate hain, is liye har jawab ke peeche ki wajah yaad rakhein.
